title: Sudden Death — Shrinking Arena hazard fires at round-timer = 60s, forces stalemate resolution
intent: Kaboom Crew rounds occasionally drag past the 90s timeout into a 'draw' — the least satisfying outcome. Two cowardly bombers refusing to engage produce silent stalemates. SUDDEN DEATH fixes this: at the 60-second mark (mid-round, 30s before timeout), a wall of red-glowing hard blocks starts closing in from the arena edges, one ring per 2 seconds. Bombers caught in the closing wall die instantly. The playable space shrinks to a smaller and smaller central zone, forcing engagement OR producing a clear last-bomber-standing resolution. Pure pacing fix — no new combat mechanic, just spatial pressure. Universal feature across Bomberman R, Super Animal Royale, Brawl Stars; the gap in Kaboom Crew is glaring after multiplayer landed.
rationale: Source: `docs/game-design/competitor-analysis.md §3.1` (highest impact-to-cost adoption from the modern-arcade-multiplayer field) + `gameplay-systems.md §6.2` (current 'round timeout → draw' rule is acknowledged as least-satisfying). Builds on the established hazard pattern from Conveyor (S146) + Warp (S149) + Pressure Plate (S151) — same module shape: schema + system + scene authoring + visual + sound. The shrinking-wall mechanism is well-trodden — Bomberman R players already understand 'when the wall closes, fight or die'.
acceptanceHints: examples/kaboom-crew/schemas/scene-extensions.schema.json:
SuddenDeathConfig component (singleton on the kaboom.game-state entity):
enabled: boolean (default true)
triggerAtElapsedS: number (default 60 — 30s before the 90s timeout)
ringIntervalS: number (default 2 — one new ring every 2 seconds)
ringWidth: number (default 1 — rings are 1 cell wide)
No per-arena tuning yet — uses the same shrinking pattern on all arenas. Each arena's natural centre is the final-cell target.
examples/kaboom-crew/src/systems/sudden-death-system.ts: NEW.
Reads SuddenDeathConfig + RoundState.elapsed.
When elapsed >= triggerAtElapsedS AND SuddenDeath has not yet activated: emit a 'sudden-death-started' audio event + screen-edge red pulse + fade banner ('SUDDEN DEATH').

Every ringIntervalS seconds after activation: spawn a new ring of HARD BLOCK entities at the next outermost playable cells. Use the arena's bounds (gridWidth × gridHeight from the loaded scene) to compute the ring.

Ring blocks have a `SuddenDeathBlock` tag so they're distinguishable from arena hard blocks. When spawned on a cell already containing a bomber → bomber dies (alive=false flip, with the new SuddenDeathBlock as the killer for kill-credit purposes — same code path as blast kills with a non-bomb damage source).
When spawned on a cell containing a bomb → bomb destroyed (same as blast).
When spawned on a cell containing a pickup → pickup destroyed.
Bombers can NOT escape into already-collapsed rings — those cells are permanent hard blocks for the rest of the round.
VISUAL TREATMENT:

Sudden-death blocks: same hard-block mesh as arena walls BUT with a red glowing emissive accent (palette.accent variant — bright red `#ff4040` from visual-style.md §5.3 reserved colour 'imminent-danger red').
Animation: each new ring of blocks appears via a 0.3s upward-rise tween (block emerges from below grid level → settles into place). Sells the 'closing-in' read.
Screen-edge red pulse: a brief vignette tween that pulses red around the screen edge for 0.5s at sudden-death activation. One-time visual cue.
Centre banner: 'SUDDEN DEATH' text in big cream font (24px from visual-style.md §8.1) with red H0 background tint, 1.5s display. Reuses the existing round-resolve banner Renderer.
AUDIO:
'sudden-death-started' event: rising klaxon synth (0.8s, descending whine).
'sudden-death-ring' event: low rumble + impact thud, fires per ring spawn. Lower volume (~0.5x) than the started event so the spawned-rings audio doesn't dominate.
Voice synth: bomber's 'hit' vocal slot fires for each bomber when the first ring spawns (collective 'oh no' moment). Optional polish.
GAMEPLAY IMPLICATIONS:

Round flow change: rounds resolve naturally as the wall shrinks. Total round time bounded — even if no engagement happens, the wall reaches the centre after ~15 rings (15 × 2s = 30s), leaving a 1-cell playable zone where the last bombers must die.

RoundState.timeLimit: unchanged at 90s. Sudden death starts at 60s, gives 30s of shrinking-arena. By 90s timeout, the wall has shrunk to ~15 cells removed per side; if anyone's still alive in a draw scenario, the timeout draw still resolves at 90s. Sudden death + timeout work TOGETHER.
Bombs caught in the closing wall: destroyed. The pre-existing chain-reaction logic isn't affected; bombs that detonate before the wall reaches them blast normally.
Multi-bot solo with 4 bombers: walls close in equally for everyone, the smallest survivors of the engagement win.
BOT AI:
Bot's danger map gains a 'imminent-sudden-death-cell' source. Cells about to be sealed by the wall (within the next 2 ringInterval ticks) are weighted as severe danger.
Bots flee toward the arena centre once sudden death triggers (the centre is the LAST cell to seal). All personality variants share this behaviour — sudden death is universal, not personality-mixed.
MULTIPLAYER (post-S125 server-authoritative):
Server runs sudden-death-system. Ring spawns are part of the server snapshot. All clients see the same shrinking schedule.
Server's seeded RNG isn't needed — sudden-death is deterministic from RoundState.elapsed.
ACCEPTANCE PLAYTEST:
Round runs with no engagement → at 60s, screen pulses red + banner shows + red blocks start appearing from edges.
Bombers flee toward centre. Each subsequent ring spawn removes one ring's worth of cells.
At ~75s, the playable area is ~half the arena.
At ~90s, the playable area is ~3 cells; bombers are forced into adjacent cells; final blast resolves.
Round-resolve fires last-bomber-standing in the small final zone, or `draw` if all bombers dead simultaneously.
URL CONFIG:
`?suddenDeath=off` disables — useful for testing AND for slow-paced learning modes.
`?suddenDeathTriggerS=N` overrides the default 60s trigger. Useful for testing the system without waiting full rounds.

DETERMINISM: ring spawn is deterministic from RoundState.elapsed; bot decisions deterministic per fixedUpdate dt. Bot-vs-bot regression continues to resolve within budget — likely FASTER with sudden death since it forces engagement.
UNIT TESTS:
At elapsed = 60s, sudden death triggers + 'sudden-death-started' audio fires once.
Every 2s after trigger, one ring of cells is converted to SuddenDeathBlock.
Bomber on a cell being converted → alive=false (with kill credit to the SuddenDeathBlock for non-blast damage path).
Bomb on a cell being converted → destroyed.
Sudden death disable via SuddenDeathConfig.enabled=false → trigger never fires.
Round-restart → SuddenDeath state resets to 'not yet activated'.
OUT OF SCOPE:
Variable shrink patterns per arena (e.g. cross-shaped shrink). All arenas use rectangular ring-closing.
Bomber-sacrifices-to-delay-shrink (e.g. holding a special pickup pauses the shrink). Out — sudden death is universal pressure.
Visual variations on the closing wall (e.g. fire / poison / ice themed walls). Single red-glow shrink for now.
Sudden death in solo mode being optional (players who want to chill). The URL override handles this; no in-game toggle.
Sudden death scoring (e.g. 'survived to X seconds' achievement). Stretch follow-up after the mechanic ships.
